title: The Athlete as a Scientist of One: Agentic Bayesian Experimental Design for Individualized Physiology from Consumer Wearables
abstract: arXiv:2610.40370v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents for personal health read wearable data and recommend, but do not learn about the individual in a way that can be audited or falsified. We present EpiCoach, an agentic system that treats one athlete, a cross-country mountain biker, as the subject of accountable N-of-1 science. Claims about the athlete live in an evidence-gated hypothesis registry: each must issue a probabilistic prediction about a future session before it occurs, and its belief moves only through computed evidence from a logged statistical fit. Predictions come from a mechanistic digital twin inferred from heart rate, GPS and barometric altitude: a lagged heart-rate response model, a fitness-fatigue model with learned time constants, and a latent technical-descending skill state, measured on discovered trail segments. translated_title: 作为“单一受试者科学家”的运动员：基于消费级可穿戴设备的个体化生理学智能体贝叶斯实验设计
translated_abstract: 面向个人健康的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够读取可穿戴设备数据并给出建议，但无法以可审计、可证伪的方式学习个体特征。我们提出EpiCoach，一个将一名运动员（山地自行车越野车手）视为可问责的单受试者（N-of-1）科学研究对象的智能体系统。关于运动员的所有论断都存放在一个证据把关的假设注册表中：每条假设必须在训练实际发生前对未来训练环节作出概率性预测，且其信念只能通过基于记录在案的统计拟合所计算的证据来更新。预测来自一个由心率、GPS和气压海拔数据推断的机制性数字孪生模型：包括滞后心率响应模型、具有学习时间常数的体能-疲劳模型，以及在自动发现的赛道段上测量的潜在技术性下坡技能状态。该智能体将下一周的训练安排规定为一个受约束的实验，在负荷等约束条件下最大化信息增益。
tldr: 提出EpiCoach系统，将运动员作为可问责的单受试者科学对象，通过证据把关的假设注册表与基于可穿戴数据的机制性数字孪生模型，把每周训练设计为最大化信息增益的受约束实验，从而实现可审计、可证伪的个体化生理建模。
en_tdlr: EpiCoach treats a single athlete as an accountable N-of-1 science subject, combining an evidence-gated hypothesis registry with a mechanistic digital twin built from wearable data, and prescribes each training week as a constrained experiment maximizing information gain for auditable, falsifiable individualized physiology.
